attributes.board_name: Delaware Board of Medical Licensure and Discipline

rules.accepted_credit_types: 50 hours Category I and 50 hours Category 2 courses approved by the AMA, or equivalent courses approved by the AOA
rules.alternatives: Current certification from the NCCPA satisfies the CME requirement (instead of the 50 + 50 hours).
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: licensed less than one year - no CME; more than one but less than two years - 50 hours.
rules.audit_note: Enter CME in the DELPROS CE Tracker; upload the NCCPA CME record or course certificates only if selected for random audit.

topics.who: All Board licensees incl. PAs, before every renewal: recognizing child sexual and physical abuse, exploitation and domestic violence, and reporting obligations (Office of the Child Advocate course)
Covered by the same 1-hour mandatory reporting training

Holders of a Delaware Controlled Substance registration (incl. PA CSR): controlled substance prescribing, chronic pain treatment or related topics, per CSR period July 1 - June 30 of odd-numbered years; the same hours from the practitioner license count

rules.notes: Renewal period runs April 1 to March 31 of even-numbered years.
rules.legal_basis: Board Rules and Regulations Section 13.2.2; 24 Del. C. §1723
rules.rule_quote: Active Physician Assistants must complete 100 hours of approved CME during each full licensure renewal periods between April 1 and March 31 even-numbered years (2018-2020, etc.).
